parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4 and an indication for cardiovascular disease. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter indication_label or mesh_heading for cardiovascular disease. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles (INNER JOIN compound_structures), indication_curie (efo_id), indication_label (efo_term or mesh_heading), and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
